t: A series of hoof-like marks in the snow continuing through the countryside for some 40 to 100 miles (60 to 160 km) were discovered in Devon, England.
The precursor of Michigan State University in East Lansing was founded as the United States' first agricultural college.
A group of American mercenaries led by William Walker set sail from San Francisco to conquer Nicaragua.
Thieves stole 224 pounds (102 kg) of gold from a train travelling from London to Folkestone, England.
Firefighters in Toronto, Canada, destroyed the infrastructure of a visiting circus; police refusal to identify rioters caused widespread protest and a complete redesign of the city's police service.
